description:
Part retrospective application for the erection of a
single storey rear and side wrap around extension
and a first floor rear extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: PH-40BR-03(Rev.A), received 23/08/2023. PH-40BR-01(Rev.A), PH-40BR-02(Rev.A), Received: 22/08/2023. Fire Safety Statement, received 22/06/2023.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side and rear elevation of the development hereby permitted.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings/enclosures within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out, other than as shown in the approved drawings, and no additional floor space shall be formed within the building(s) hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division (new mezzanine level) without prior written approval of the local planning authority.
